Name: Better Crop Fairy
Author: daniel4242
Description:
[center]Better Crop Fairy Mod Overview:
Transform the random crop fairy event into an immersive, player-controlled
experience! Instead of letting the fairy randomly choose which crops to
grow, [b]Better Crop Fairy[/b] puts you in control while maintaining the magical charm of the original event.[/center]

[b]Features
[/b][b]
Enhanced Fairy Experience[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Cinematic Morning Sequence[/b]: Wake up to an animated fairy scene with custom dialogue and visual effects
[*][b]Authentic Visuals[/b]: Uses the actual Stardew Valley fairy sprite with proper animation frames
[*][b]Immersive Atmosphere[/b]: Screen fades to black with time frozen during the magical reveal
[/list][b]Player Control

[/b][list]
[*][b]Choose Your Area[/b]: Select exactly which 5x5 area of crops you want the fairy to bless
[*][b]Strategic Planning[/b]: Target your most valuable or time-sensitive crops
[*][b]No More Randomness[/b]: Eliminate wasted fairy visits on less important crops
[/list][b]Design[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Farmhouse-Only Events[/b]: Fairy only visits when you sleep in your farmhouse (not in tents, Ginger Island, or other locations)
[*][b]Natural Progression[/b]: Morning event triggers first, then fairy selection becomes available when you step outside
[*][b]Vanilla-Compatible[/b]: Works seamlessly with the existing game without breaking immersion
[/list][b]Quality of Life[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Unskippable Cinematic[/b]: Enjoy the full magical experience without accidental skipping
[*][b]Proper Timing[/b]: Only trigger's after you leave your farmhouse
[b]
[/b][/list][b]How It Works[/b]

[list=1]
[*][b]Interception[/b]: When the vanilla crop fairy event would normally occur, this mod intercepts it

[*][b]Morning Magic[/b]: The next morning, you'll experience a cinematic sequence revealing the fairy's visit

[*][b]Player Choice[/b]: After leaving your farmhouse, you can select any 5x5 area to instantly grow
[b]
[/b][/list][b]Perfect For[/b]

[list]
[*]Players who want more control over random events
[*]Min-maxers looking to optimize fairy visits
[*]Anyone who loves the fairy event but hates the randomness
[/list]
